{
  "name": "usage-bar",
  "displayName": "Usage Bar",
  "version": "0.2.3",
  "description": "Your 5-hour and weekly usage limits, context window and session cost as colour-graded bars above the prompt",
  "author": {
    "name": "overvac",
    "url": "https://github.com/overvac"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/overvac/usage-bar",
  "repository": "https://github.com/overvac/usage-bar",
  "icon": "./assets/icon.png",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/overvac/usage-bar#readme",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/overvac/usage-bar/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/overvac/usage-bar#privacy-and-safety",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "usage",
    "usage-limits",
    "rate-limits",
    "context-window",
    "cost",
    "status-line",
    "mod"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "show_cost": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show session cost",
      "description": "The estimated cost of the session in US dollars",
      "default": true
    },
    "show_context": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show context window",
      "description": "How full the context window is",
      "default": true
    },
    "show_five_hour": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show 5-hour limit",
      "description": "Your 5-hour usage limit and its reset countdown (Pro and Max plans)",
      "default": true
    },
    "show_weekly": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show weekly limit",
      "description": "Your weekly usage limit and its reset countdown (Pro and Max plans)",
      "default": true
    },
    "show_last_change": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show last change",
      "description": "How long ago any of the figures last changed",
      "default": true
    },
    "show_pace": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show pace on limit bars",
      "description": "Lightens each limit bar's empty track up to where even use of the window would be",
      "default": true
    }
  }
}
